verdict.rationale: Obsidian has a dedicated developer-docs site (obsidian-developer-docs) with a documented API (Vault interface, TypeScript-based plugin API on GitHub obsidian-api), a 'Build a plugin' tutorial that walks through compiling a sample plugin from source and loading it, and separate docs for CSS theming/snippets. This covers documented API + samples + developer docs as requested. Missing for 10: broader independent hands-on corroboration of the SDK's completeness/quality beyond the official tutorial, and more extensive sample coverage beyond the single 'Build a plugin' walkthrough.
